## Checklist

- [ ] `make lint` and `make test` pass locally
- [ ] Tests added/updated for the change (a masking/engine change includes a
      test that checks the *target database's* foreign keys, not just that
      code ran)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a bullet under `## [Unreleased]` (skip for
      internal-only changes with no user-visible effect)
- [ ] Docs (README/CONTRIBUTING) updated if behavior or setup changed
